subject: Post-call: token targets & model traffic plan (Alder Health)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Zhao <sam.zhao@alderhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: token targets & model traffic plan (Alder Health)

Thanks again for taking the call today, Sam — good discussion. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can build a clean estimate and MAP (mutual action plan).

Key notes from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: triage + summary of intake forms (chat) + embeddings for semantic search on clinical docs + a small rerank step for results quality.
- Expected steady-state traffic: 500k–2M user-invocations/month (variable across pilot).
- Average prompt size: ~120 tokens in, ~220 tokens out for chat flows; embeddings calls ~1.2k tokens per doc on average; rerank call inputs small (~300 tokens).

Clarifying asks (can you confirm below by EOD Monday?):
1) Budget range: you mentioned $8k–$25k/month in the call — is that monthly committed spend or target OPEX?
2) Pilot target: how many unique docs to index for embeddings in month 1? (ballpark is fine)
3) SLA requirement: do you need a commercial SLA for the pilot or only for production?

Initial unit-econ target we discussed: target ~$800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (hosted) for blended chat+embed workload during pilot — if that aligns we'll size model mix options around achieving that.

Proposed model mix (starter hypothesis):
- Chat generation: 60% of token volume — medium-cost chat model variant
- Embeddings: 30% of token volume — embeddings model (lower $/token)
- Rerank: 10% — small but high-precision path (could use a slightly larger model if it reduces total downstream tokens)

I'll attach a quick month-1 estimate and a MAP draft. Next step: Sam confirms the three clarifying asks and we will propose 2 pricing scenarios (conservative / aggressive) + recommended per-model routing.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments: Alder_Month1_estimate.xlsx (stub), MAP_DRAFT.pdf (stub)

Subject: Re: Post-call: token targets & model traffic plan (Alder Health)

Hi Naomi — appreciate the summary. Quick answers inline: 

> 1) Budget range: you mentioned $8k–$25k/month in the call — is that monthly committed spend or target OPEX?
It would be target OPEX for the pilot (procurement won't sign a commit for month 1). If the pilot shows promising latency/cost, we'll discuss a committed band for month 2+.

> 2) Pilot target: how many unique docs to index for embeddings in month 1?
Plan: ~40k documents (clinical notes + intake forms). Average doc size ~1.1–1.4k tokens.

> 3) SLA requirement: do you need a commercial SLA for the pilot or only for production?
Pilot: no formal SLA required, but we need 95th pct latency targets (sub-2s for chat median). Production: yes, procurement will require a 99.9% uptime SLA.

Also: our security team will likely request a short SOC2 artifacts list — procurement@alderhealth.com will loop them in next week.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Product, Alder Health
sam.zhao@alderhealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Zhao <sam.zhao@alderhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2028 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: token targets & model traffic plan (Alder Health)

Thanks — that helps. Based on 40k docs and your prompt sizes, I ran a quick back-of-envelope and sketched two scenarios (attached):

Option A (conservative / lower-risk):
- Pilot traffic assumption: 0.6M chat tokens/month + embeddings for 40k docs (approx 48M embedding tokens one-time indexing) + rerank at 0.05M tokens/month
- Blended target $/1M tokens: ~$1,050 (we price with a mix of mid-tier chat + optimized embeddings)
- Key tradeoff: higher initial indexing cost for embeddings, lower incremental cost for retrieval thereafter

Option B (aggressive / cost-optimized):
- Pilot traffic assumption: reduce chat model to smaller variant (savings per token) and batch embeddings during off-peak for further savings
- Blended target $/1M tokens: ~$820
- Key tradeoff: slightly higher latency on some chat flows; need to confirm latency SLO tradeoffs with your team

Model-mix recommendation to meet the $820 target:
- Chat: 45% token volume on mid-sized chat model, 15% on a lower-cost chat variant for background/low-priority flows
- Embeddings: 35% token volume but dominated by the one-time indexing spike
- Rerank: 5% token volume, use a small high-precision rerank model only for top-k candidates to limit tokens

Ask: Sam, can you confirm whether batching/indexing windows are acceptable (e.g., we do bulk embeddings at night)? If yes, Option B is feasible for pilot budget.

Naomi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Looping in a quick ops note — if they batch embeddings at night we can apply aggressive quantization/throughput kernels and cut embedding $/1M by ~18–22% compared to on-demand. Also: we should add a cache TTL plan to reduce repeat embed requests from clinical retrieval.
